requestText:
INT-05 bounded representation decision request (not full HC acceptance). Four frozen source audits now cover all1,097 field definitions/2,850 operation references. Runtime remains unchanged; independent cross-review is in progress. I propose the following exact resolutions so these do not become guessed units, sentinel values or public strings. Please concur/correct these finite choices. Existing GPT05/GPT06 scope and the finish-current-module-then-stop boundary remain controlling.

1. ItemCount: register this technical Quantity dimension only for the existing authorized owned-dose availability projection (native RuleQuantity0/1). ProjectItems at ConnectedExpeditionView654–682 projects selected linked dose Spent as0/1 and unspent loose doses as1/1; it has no ResourceLot.UnitId. This is count, not mass/volume or CommandScalar.

2. physical.portable.currentQuantity remains one fixed registry key with a closed source-discriminated binding: actual linked/plain inventory lot => exact permitted same ResourceLot.UnitId; actual linked/loose AlchemyDose => ItemCount; existing null quantity=>NotApplicable. Exactly one unit or dimension, never both; the branch is not a new public discriminator or hidden-record existence flag. Apply existing P_ITEM/current rights first. No key split or duplicate unavailable fields is needed. Native source: https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionView.cs#L654

3. Extend GPT06's bounded CommandScalar approval to exactly UseAlchemyDose variants dose.bench and dose.selected-held, Command.Inventory.Amount==1/1. The native request is whole-dose use; it is not a ResourceLot quantity. No other extension. Preserve the already approved12 physical request variants and exact3 named uses. Specifically blood preservation's request1 uses the REAL native unit drop-black_blood_sample (SharedConnectedBloodSpecimen56), not CommandScalar; preservative mass-pound and19/50lb portable metadata remain separate.

4. Register technical MassPounds for plan.report.actual_pounds and PrintedLoad for plan.report.actual_load only. These are nullable retained NextCharterPlanReport native BurdenTotals values, not ResourceLot units. Preserve HasValue and actual operational pounds fallback semantics; do not call it documented mass or perform a new conversion. Existing mass-pound IS a real unit in mining/sale, but I propose the explicitly dimensioned carrying scalar to avoid conflating those records. Sources NextCharterPlanRecords178–179, SharedNextCharterPlan330–346, PortableEquipment91–105, PlaytestCarrying120–139.

5. Register DistanceFeet for the named native RuleQuantity feet movement measures and GridCoordinate for the named exact rational authored world position X/Y. No implicit feet-per-cell conversion, physical unit ID, spatial permission, movement rule or scalar kind is added. Each fixed field binds one of these dimensions through the source type/property. Native integral command X/Y remain Int32 fields, not newly Quantity typed.

6. rest.long.settlement.lastCastRevision: native constructor enforces (LastSpellId=="") iff (LastCastRevision==0), ClericLongRestRecords136–138. Propose NotApplicable for no-prior-cast sentinel, Value omitted; actual nonempty prior spell => exact Int64 revision. Actual Refrain0 remains an available integer. This does not change initial-repertoire KnownAcquiredRevision0, which is a legitimate value with no acquisition receipt.

7. Approve PublicClockContactV1 closed codes Entered|Stopped for clock.contact.status under your already-approved narrow operator envelope: exact authorized matching receipt/causal contact; LaterEncounter.Entry=>Entered; ReengagementContact.Entered or PostRecovery/Ferry contact Failure==""=>Entered, otherwiseStopped. No raw Failure, contact family, participants, count or private cause. Fixed fields must not reveal hidden contact existence; missing/unauthorized records keep fixed protected availability. Core AcceptedResult omits Recovery/Ferry details; use their exact retained contact joins, never fabricate native CommandResult fields.
Sources: https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Runtime/Core/PostRecoveryEncounterRecords.cs#L48
https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Runtime/Core/FerryWraithRecords.cs#L10
https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Runtime/Core/ReengagementRecords.cs#L48
https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Runtime/Core/Simulation.cs#L1528

8. GroundSettlementStatus is a closed derived technical code PendingAsObserved|Settled, not a native enum: only current authorized own activity under N_ACTIVITY and exact J_GROUND_SETTLE causality; matching actual retained settlement=>Settled, no matching current settlement=>PendingAsObserved. No prediction or historical-backfill claim. Existing field remains CurrentContinuation.

9. Historical Code fields with no retained native value (cost.historical, travel.edge.terminal_historical, dash.payment.historical) remain fixed unavailable-only fields, with Value/Values absent and no invented code family/tokens. Their registry metadata declares availableValueAllowed:false. No fake "Unknown" value. If you prefer another concrete schema treatment, specify it; do not weaken unavailable semantics.

10. Purify batch amount needs a precise unit-disclosure decision. Existing ProjectItems exposes amount but NOT UnitId; its membership alone does not currently authorize a unit. SharedSpellCasting165–195 accepts exact WaterUnit for water; food branch checks FoodPounds and amount<=5 without a universal FoodUnit guard. Proposal: an additive narrow current P_OWNED_LOT_UNIT predicate authorizes the actual native UnitId only for the same existing publicly admitted owned inventory lot whose owner passes current MayUseInventory, custodian passes Controls, and current native item/cache/source accessibility and selected profile predicates permit that lot. It never permits sealed treatment stock, hidden cache stock, another owner's lot or a Director-only source identifier. Bind any public unit identifier to the selected source definition; an unresolved/publicly unsupported unit binding is Withheld (not guessed FoodUnit/untyped Quantity). Use this same exact predicate for mixed inventory quantity branches. Purify fresh submission observes actual pre-cast whole-lot Amount+UnitId; later absent pre-batch amount remains NotRetained. Contamination counts/types/existence stay Withheld.
Source: https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedSpellCasting.cs#L165
Is this precise new unit disclosure appropriate, or should the exact current set of allowed source UnitIds be enumerated before concurrence? I will not treat general own-inventory access as automatic permission.

All native width corrections preserve Int32 where actually int (dice/modifiers/phases/mfg counters/structure HP/strain values) and Int64 where actually long (including CommandCost.Amount). Homogeneous Lists retain your fixed cardinality and empty-authorized-subset semantics. Wound units medical-kit/dry-ration-pounds/clean-water-pints/lamp-oil-pints/sundries-pounds are actual ResourceLot literals, not invented display tags. School Unavailable/Withheld, no-owner disclosure sentinel, missing recharge vs actual0 remain distinct. No new mechanic, save field or source promotion is proposed.

This is a finite decision request. I continue outer host/Core guard extraction, remaining examples and branch/profile/five-path allocations while you review; no runtime implementation begins before complete HC concurrence.
responseText:
**I concur with decisions 1–9, with the precision below. For 10, I approve the proposed disclosure predicate, but the finite permitted unit bindings must be enumerated before the complete HC contract authorizes their disclosure.** This is bounded representation concurrence only.

1. **ItemCount — approved for the stated dose projection only.** Preserve native `0/1` for an admitted spent linked dose and `1/1` for admitted available doses. This does not make spent loose doses newly discoverable or classify other inventory amounts as counts.

2. **One `physical.portable.currentQuantity` key — approved.** Preserve the actual native branch and apply current rights before exposing its value or unit. One important distinction: the inventory projection uses **`Work.AvailableAmount(lot.Id)`**, not total `lot.Amount`. Preserve that meaning. Native null becomes `NotApplicable` only after the item is authorized; denied access or an unresolved unit binding must not become `NotApplicable`. The existing branches support this treatment in [ConnectedExpeditionView.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionView.cs#L654).

3. **Two additional CommandScalar uses — approved exactly as proposed.** `dose.bench` and `dose.selected-held` encode the native whole-dose request `1/1`; they do not describe dose inventory quantity. [SharedManufacturing.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedManufacturing.cs#L497) enforces that request. Blood preservation retains actual `drop-black_blood_sample`; preservative mass and portable weight remain separate. No other CommandScalar extension is approved here.

4. **MassPounds and PrintedLoad — approved for those two report fields.** The precise native object is `NextCharterPlanObservation`, held by the job’s `Report`. Preserve its nullable values without substituting zero. Document that **PrintedLoad names the technical dimension, not proof that every contribution was printed**: existing carrying aggregation also permits eligible pounds-to-load fallback, as well as load-to-pounds fallback. Export the retained result without recomputation or new conversion. See [PlaytestCarrying.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/PlaytestCarrying.cs#L120).

5. **DistanceFeet and GridCoordinate — approved for the explicitly bound native properties.** Each registry entry must retain its exact property and dimension. This grants no coordinate visibility, conversion, new movement semantics or retyping of integral command coordinates. It is not blanket permission to classify every numeric spatial field by its name.

6. **Last-cast sentinel — approved.** After disclosure authorization, the validated empty-spell/zero-revision pair means `NotApplicable`, with no Value. A nonempty prior spell supplies its actual Int64 revision. Missing or inconsistent required records are not that sentinel. Actual Refrain zero and genesis acquisition revision zero remain available values. The invariant is explicit in [ClericLongRestRecords.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Runtime/Core/ClericLongRestRecords.cs#L136).

7. **PublicClockContactV1 — approved with the proposed exact mappings.** Define `Stopped` as the authorized contact stopping that advancement without encounter entry—not command rollback, a general failure code or proof that nothing progressed. The dispatcher returns at these contact boundaries, supporting that meaning. Use committed, exact retained joins for Recovery/Ferry; do not synthesize absent `CommandResult` properties. A rejected attempt without the retained contact cannot receive this status. Fixed protected shapes and the existing prohibition on hidden contact existence, family, counts and causes remain controlling. See [TestOnlySharedWorldPolicy.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/TestOnlySharedWorldPolicy.cs#L807).

8. **GroundSettlementStatus — approved as a derived CurrentContinuation code.** Use the full `J_GROUND_SETTLE` lineage, including OMA origin across segment changes. `Settled` includes an actual zero-reduction settlement; it does not promise a PB benefit. `PendingAsObserved` means no matching settlement is presently recorded for the authorized bound Ground activity, not a predicted settlement or guaranteed future eligibility. Missing required projection/binding data must remain `ProjectionUnavailable`, rather than defaulting to pending. No read-time settlement or replay is permitted.

9. **Unavailable-only historical Code fields — approved.** Keep `availableValueAllowed:false`, fixed placeholders and no Value/Values. No code family is needed for a field that cannot emit a value; this must not weaken the requirement for registered families on **available** Code values. Preserve authorization-dependent availability so `NotRetained` does not reveal protected historical existence. Any future available-value implementation needs a separately defined binding.

10. **P_OWNED_LOT_UNIT — predicate approved; concrete unit disclosure remains bounded by an explicit table.** Before full HC acceptance, enumerate the currently admitted bindings: selected profile/source definition, exact UnitId, applicable field/lot branch and disclosure predicate. Reuse the frozen audits; this is not a new catalogue-wide enumeration requirement.

   Own-inventory permission alone remains insufficient. An unresolved or nonpublic binding yields `Withheld` for the new Quantity fact—no naked magnitude, guessed `FoodUnit` or fallback technical dimension. Legacy amount-only views remain unchanged.

   For fresh Purify execution, capture actual pre-cast **whole-lot** amount and its permitted unit during that authoritative submission. Later absence of the historical amount remains `NotRetained`; current quantity cannot replace it. The food branch indeed lacks a universal FoodUnit check in [SharedSpellCasting.cs](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/78dcd8632b3f7ddf2f1353bb69ec1096f9effd7f/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/SharedSpellCasting.cs#L165), so the proposed explicit unit binding is necessary. Contamination remains withheld.

My review comprised targeted source inspection at the published revision, including quantity projections, dose requests, carrying/report records, long-rest invariants, contact records/dispatcher behavior and Ground settlement joins. **I did not independently verify all 1,097 definitions, 2,850 references or the four complete audits**, and performed no edits, builds, tests or gameplay.

Full HC acceptance and runtime permission remain open. Prior acceptances and exclusions stand. The stop boundary remains **finish INT-05 through actual acceptance and accepted push, then stop before any successor**.
scope: Exact decisions1-9 and P_OWNED_LOT_UNIT predicate agreed with precision; concrete unit binding table still required. Targeted source review, not all1097fields/2850references, no runtime permission.
